// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / classes / constructors
class Counter {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    public readonly value: int32;
    constructor(readonly label: string) {}
}

// types / classes / inheritance and abstract members
abstract class Logger {
// <- meta.type.definition.ds
    abstract write(message: string): void;
}

// types / classes / overrides
class ConsoleLogger extends Logger {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    override write(message: string): void {}
}

class BufferedLogger extends Logger {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    virtual write(message: string): void {}
//  ^^^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds
}
